buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS & CONDITIONS (ATC) FOR CONSTRUCTION OF RCC UNDERGROUND BUNKER A. SCOPE OF WORK 1. The successful bidder shall carry out construction of RCC Underground Bunker including excavation, fou ndation, RCC structure, reinforcement, waterproofing, backfilling and allied civil works as per approved dra wings and specifications. 2. The bidder shall execute the complete work on a turnkey basis as per the scope specified in the BID. 3. The RCC bunker shall be constructed using approved grade of concrete as specified by the structural de sign engineer. 4. The structural design shall consider soil conditions, groundwater level, earth pressure, imposed loads a nd other applicable structural requirements. 5. The bidder shall provide all required construction materials, machinery, equipment, manpower and supe rvision. 6. All construction work shall conform to applicable BIS standards and approved departmental specification s. 7. Proper waterproofing and drainage arrangements shall be provided to prevent seepage and water accu mulation. 8. Ventilation, lighting, access arrangements and emergency exit provisions shall be provided wherever sp ecified in the approved drawings. B. BIDDER ELIGIBILITY 9. The bidder shall possess valid GST registration and PAN. 10. The bidder should have a minimum average annual turnover of Rs. 3,00,000 during the last three com pleted financial years, subject to applicable procurement rules and exemptions. 11. The bidder shall submit a CA-certified turnover certificate with UDIN wherever applicable. 12. The bidder should possess relevant experience in RCC construction, underground civil works or compar able structural construction work. 13. The bidder shall submit relevant work orders and satisfactory completion certificates. 14. The bidder should have successfully completed at least one similar work valued at Rs. 3,60,000 or equi valent qualifying work experience permitted under applicable procurement rules. 15. The bidder shall submit a non-blacklisting declaration confirming that the firm is not currently debarre d by any government department or public procurement authority. 16. The bidder shall deploy qualified technical personnel and competent site supervisors. 17. The bidder shall submit a proposed work execution methodology and completion schedule. C. OEM & MANUFACTURER REQUIREMENTS 18. The bidder shall submit relevant cement manufacturer test certificates confirming compliance with ap plicable BIS standards.

19. The bidder shall submit TMT reinforcement steel manufacturer test certificates confirming compliance with IS 1786. 20. For proprietary waterproofing systems, the bidder shall submit manufacturer authorization or supply as surance wherever technically justified. 21. Bid-specific OEM Authorization shall be submitted for specialized manufactured equipment, where requ ired by the approved technical specifications. 22. OEM Authorization, wherever applicable, shall mention the GeM Bid Number, bidder name and relevant product details. 23. OEM Turnover Certificates shall be required only for specialized manufactured equipment where a pro portionate financial eligibility requirement is technically justified. 24. Manufacturer quality certificates and relevant product test reports shall be submitted for applicable m aterials and manufactured equipment. 25. The bidder shall submit manufacturer warranty certificates for applicable proprietary products and spe cialized equipment. 26. All supplied manufactured products shall be genuine, new and unused. 27. The department reserves the right to verify the authenticity of manufacturer-issued documents. D. QUALITY CONTROL & TESTING 28. Cement, reinforcement steel, aggregates and other construction materials shall conform to approved s pecifications. 29. Concrete shall be mixed, placed, compacted and cured in accordance with applicable engineering stan dards. 30. Concrete cube tests shall be carried out as required by the approved quality assurance plan. 31. Reinforcement inspection shall be completed before concrete placement. 32. Waterproofing materials and completed waterproofing works shall be tested wherever required by the contract. 33. Applicable material tests shall be carried out through a NABL-accredited or other department-approved laboratory. 34. The contractor shall maintain quality inspection and testing records. 35. Substandard materials or defective construction work shall be rejected and rectified at the contractor's cost. E. SAFETY & EXECUTION 36. The contractor shall follow applicable excavation safety and construction safety requirements. 37. Adequate excavation shoring, barricading and dewatering arrangements shall be provided wherever re quired. 38. The contractor shall provide appropriate personal protective equipment to workers. 39. Existing underground utilities shall be identified and protected before excavation. 40. The contractor shall arrange safe disposal of excavated material and construction waste in accordance with applicable rules. 41. The contractor shall obtain statutory permissions and clearances assigned to the contractor under the contract. 42. The bidder shall be responsible for site safety, workmanship and protection of adjoining structures duri ng execution. F. INSPECTION & DOCUMENTATION 43. The buyer or authorized representative may inspect construction materials and workmanship during ex ecution. 44. The contractor shall submit approved material details, relevant test certificates and quality inspection records. 45. The contractor shall submit as-built drawings and completion documentation wherever required. 46. The contractor shall rectify defects identified during departmental inspection before final acceptance. 47. Any changes to approved structural drawings or specifications shall require prior written approval from the competent authority. G. FINANCIAL & CONTRACTUAL CONDITIONS 48. EMD, if applicable, shall be Rs. 18,000 (2% of estimated bid value), subject to the applicable procurem ent rules and eligible exemptions. 49. Performance Security shall be furnished by the successful bidder as prescribed under applicable procu rement rules and bid conditions.

50. The work shall be completed within the period specified in the contract. 51. Payment shall be released as per verified measurements, satisfactory work completion and approved c ontractual milestones. 52. The contractor shall rectify defects during the prescribed defect liability period, proposed as 12 months unless departmental rules specify otherwise. 53. ISO 9001 certification may be considered where relevant and proportionate to the work. ISO 14001 an d ISO 45001 may be accepted as supporting credentials but shall not automatically be mandatory eligibilit y conditions. 54. The successful bidder shall comply with all applicable GeM General Terms & Conditions, contractual co nditions and relevant government procurement rules. In case of inconsistency, the applicable governing ru les shall prevail. .
